text: hey so i want to see if anything is possible here but so there is a model that is the van_seat_soup which was generated in tripo. i did a by hand retopology of it, and it is the car_backseats; im wondering if you could compare the two, and do some reverse engineering to help shape the agent seat skill for being able to help steer how to retopology a model properly when an agent is asked to do so
resolution: Compared the Tripo soup (Van_Seat_Soup GLB: 1998 tris, 26 intersecting shells, zero mirror symmetry) against the hand retopo (car_backseats RJMD v4 doc.blob) by parsing both binaries directly. Recovered the actual build order from the blob's face-group creation sequence: right half first, mirrored left block second, then full-width quad band rows, closeout last. Measured the finished shape of done — 50% tri budget, 480 quads/49 pole-only triangles, 26-to-6 shell fusion, 8mm median surface fidelity, 95% imposed bilateral symmetry, adaptive 14-190mm quad sizing, hardware dropped to paint. Distilled all of it into a new 'Retopology playbook — the measured reference retopo' section in .agents/skills/agent-seat/SKILL.md with target metrics, deliberate-drop guidance, the measured build order mapped onto mirror-replace/retopo-bands/weld-pairs, and a name-as-you-go correction (the exemplar's own semantic table is empty — SEMBLOB debt agents must not repeat).
